information.description:
Militech's offer to an operator reduced to little more than a brain: rise again as a one-borg demolition squad. The catch is a lifetime in Internal Security, usually inside some covert facility. Few people meet one, and fewer walk away.

Cost: 97,700eb
Humanity Loss: 74 ([2d6/2 Round Up] + 22d6)
Frame: Omega (16): BODY 16
Eyes: As listed
Base chrome (no HL): Hausstock-W Arms [Built in Gorilla Arm (w/ Tungsten Reinforcement) & Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade], Internal Linear Frame Omega (w/ Bionic Joints), Rocklin Augmentics Skydrivers [Built-in Jump Boosters], Xtremsight Cybereye ×2 [Built in MicroOptics, Opti-Zoom, & TeleOptics]
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle ×2, Combat Software (Vulnerability Analytics), FBC EMP Coating ×2, (+1 SP) Heavy Subdermal Plating (w/ Rangeguard), Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Perfected), Low Light/Infrared/UV ×2, (Oversized Weapon) Popup Ranged Weapon (w/ TUp [One-Handed] Miitech Mk.31 HMG), (+1 Capacity) Popup Grenade Launcher, Radar/Sonar Implant, Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade ×2 [Legs], Sandevistan (w/ Militech ‘Falcon’ OS), Self-ICE ×2, Targeting Scope (w/ Vulnerability Analytics)

Note: Fitting one includes 2 weeks of Intensive Therapy (cost and Humanity already counted); skip it and you come out a psychotic wreck.

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
